action.objective: Verify f4c7, the broad-search suggestion, capturing the pawn and intruding on Black's queenside.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 3 ranked f4c7 top with exact score 122, ahead of h1g1 (108, upper) and the rook shuffles (101, upper). f4c7 wins a pawn, keeps the extra bishop, and hits c7/a7 while the black king is uncastled at e8. Bound is exact so the score is trustworthy at that depth; single-move verification checks whether Black has a tactical refutation and how the line develops at depth 4.
